g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Half of students in rural Sindh cost households under Rs 4,500 a year, but
one in ten costs Rs 15,500 or more
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: students (ed_total > 0) in rural Sindh, n = 1,440. Weighted by hhweight. 1
student(s) outside Rs 100-1,000,000 excluded from the bars (statistics use all students).
